source_title: 4 killed, 11 injured as Italian Chinook helicopter crashes in Bosnia
source_excerpt: A helicopter operated by the European Union peacekeeping force in Bosnia and Herzegovina crashed during a routine training exercise in the country's north on Friday, killing four personnel on board and injuring 11 others, according to a statement from the force.The Italian CH-47 Chinook helicopter crashed in an area near the town of Brcko.
